task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head south. If you can succeed at that, take a trip east. Okay, and then, make sure that the portal within the study is wide open. And then, go east. And then, pick up the potato from the trunk. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You arrive in a vault. A standard kind of place. You start to take note of what's in the room.

You can see a rack. But the thing is empty. You move on, clearly depressed by your TextWorld experience.

There is an open gate leading north. There is an open gateway leading south. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east.

thought: I should go south first as instructed.
feedback:
Okay, so you're in a workshop, cool, but is it typical? You better believe it is. You begin to take stock of what's here.

You see a desk. The desk is typical. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Sometimes, just sometimes, TextWorld can just be the worst.

There is an open hatch leading east. There is an open gateway leading north.
